name: 赫炎之弓 Bow of Conflagration (BMT)

description.value:
武器（任意弓），珍稀（需同調）
從這把弓射出的彈藥，如同燒紅般熠熠生輝着。當你用這把弓發動的攻擊檢定命中時，目標還會受到額外的[[/damage 1d6 type=fire]]傷害。若目標是一個可燃的、非魔法物件，它還會被點燃，並在每個你的回合開始時受到[[/damage 1d6 type=fire]]傷害直至一個生物用其動作熄滅火焰爲止。

Ammunition fired from this bow blazes brightly. When you hit with an attack roll using this bow, the target takes an extra [[/damage 1d6 type=fire]] damage. If the target is a flammable, nonmagical object, it catches fire, taking [[/damage 1d6 type=fire]] damage at the start of each of your turns until a creature uses an action to extinguish the flames.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Longbow|PHB] (@item[Longbow of Conflagration|BMT])
  • @item[Shortbow|PHB] (@item[Shortbow of Conflagration|BMT])
